subject: [PATCH 55/60] mm/memory_hotplug: online and offline private memory nodes

reviews.author: Gregory Relay
reviews.summary: Reviewer noted that the patch does not check if a memory block belongs to multiple nodes before calling can_claim_node_memory(), which may lead to incorrect results.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch allows a driver to hotplug memory onto a private node at runtime by passing a feature mask through driver-managed hotplug. The patch rejects masks that are not valid according to the node_memory_features_valid() function. Memory joins a node only if it has the same feature mask as the node, and the node's features remain until all System RAM blocks are removed, even when ZONE_DEVICE memory keeps the node alive. This patch also introduces a new function can_claim_node_memory() that checks whether a node can claim its memory based on the provided feature mask.
